question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He speaks **as if he was knowing everything.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. as if he knew everything**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"knew"** is the past tense of "know," meaning to have information, understanding, or awareness of something. (जानता था)
 
 
• **English Meaning:** To be aware of something or to have knowledge of it.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** जानता था
 
• **Example:** He knew the answer to the question immediately.
 
 
• The phrase **"as if"** is used to indicate an imaginary or hypothetical situation. (जैसे कि)
 
 
• **Example:** She talks as if she owns the place.
 
 
• In this sentence, the use of "as if he knew everything" correctly conveys an unreal or hypothetical situation in the past tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. as if he knew everything**.

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: as if he knows everything** (जैसे कि वह सब कुछ जानता है): Incorrect because "knows" is in the present tense, which does not align with the hypothetical context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** He behaves as if he knows all the answers. (Present tense usage)
 
 

 
• **Option 2: as though he knew everything** (जैसे कि वह सब कुछ जानता था): Grammatically correct but less commonly used than "as if he knew everything" in modern English.
 
 
• **Example:** He spoke as though he knew the entire story.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: as he knows everything** (क्योंकि वह सब कुछ जानता है): Incorrect because it suggests a real situation, not a hypothetical one.
 
 
• **Example:** As he knows everything, he should take the lead. (Real situation)
 
 

48:T828,

The correct answer is **Option 4**.
